findings.passage: Asked in 2019 whether he would kneel or stand, he said, "I think we've moved past kneeling and I think it's time to go into actionable items."
findings.problem: S7 continues directly: 'No, I don't want people to stop protesting at all. Kneeling... is a form of protest. I support protest across the board.' Cutting that makes him sound more dismissive of the protest than he was, and the line is then used as Three evidence ('We've moved past kneeling' can read as a Three choosing the bigger platform). It cuts against the thesis rather than for it, and 'about injustice' partly offsets it, so it is minor, but it is a context omission about a living person.
findings.acceptance_test: The paragraph adds his same-breath clarification, quoted or closely paraphrased from S7 (for example: he added that he did not want people to stop protesting and supported protest 'across the board'), and C15's inference notes it.
